_comment: *'Note that playing Emiel is also possible if I don't have enough colourless.'* (USER,
2026-09-10.) Fixture 4's exact board with an Emiel added, and the Displacer listed FIRST so the
old insertion-order tie-break would pick it.
Eldrazi Displacer {2}{C} and Emiel the Blessed {3} have the SAME mana value, so the recognizer's
net/untaps comparison ties and which outlet the loop was recognised on came down to battlefield
order -- the §9 defect one column over. It is not cosmetic: the Displacer spends a colourless a
pass and Emiel spends none, so the coin flip decided whether net_c was 0 (no kill, no button) or
1 (a real deck-out). MTG_EDF_OUTLET_NETC breaks the exact tie toward the outlet that banks more
colourless, and the fixture asserts BOTH halves: the button appears, and applying it wins.
With MTG_EDF_OUTLET_NETC=0 this board goes back to ABSENT -- the one-binary A/B for the lever.
